query:
SELECT
                    l.name,
                    l.caldav_url,
                    l.ctag,
                    l.updated_at,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t
                     WHERE t.list_id = l.id
                     AND (t.local_version > t.synced_version OR t.sync_status != 'synced')) as pending_count
                FROM task_lists l
                WHERE l.id = ?
